actionType.description_en:
The action type. Valid values:
SCALE_UP_PARALLELISM: scales up parallelism.
SCALE_DOWN_PARALLELISM: scales down parallelism.
SCALE_UP_MEMORY: scales up memory.
RESTART: restarts the job
actionType.description_zh: 操作类型。如 SCALE_UP_PARALLELISM（扩并行度）、SCALE_DOWN_PARALLELISM（缩并行度）、SCALE_UP_MEMORY（扩内存）、RESTART（重启）等

tuningState.description_en:
The tuning state. Valid values:
SUCCESS: The tuning succeeded.
FAILED: The tuning failed.
EXECUTING: The tuning is in progress.
TERMINATED: The tuning was terminated.
FAILED_WITH_ROLLBACK_SUCCESS: The tuning failed but the rollback succeeded.
FAILED_WITH_ROLLBACK_FAILED: The tuning failed and the rollback also failed.
FAILED_WITH_RESOURCE_LACK: The tuning failed due to insufficient resources.
FAILED_WITH_SAME_RESOURCE_SETTING: The tuning failed because the resource configuration did not change
tuningState.description_zh: 调优状态。可选值：SUCCESS（成功）、FAILED（失败）、EXECUTING（执行中）、TERMINATED（已终止）、FAILED_WITH_ROLLBACK_SUCCESS（失败但回滚成功）、FAILED_WITH_ROLLBACK_FAILED（失败且回滚失败）、FAILED_WITH_RESOURCE_LACK（因资源不足失败）、FAILED_WITH_SAME_RESOURCE_SETTING（因资源配置未变化失败）
tuningState.title: 调优状态。可选值：SUCCESS（成功）、FAILED（失败）、EXECUTING（执行中）、TERMINATED（已终止）、FAILED_WITH_ROLLBACK_SUCCESS（失败但回滚成功）、FAILED_WITH_ROLLBACK_FAILED（失败且回滚失败）、FAILED_WITH_RESOURCE_LACK（因资源不足失败）、FAILED_WITH_SAME_RESOURCE_SETTING（因资源配置未变化失败）。
